body: @leaanthony any advise or is it better to stick with beta.18

Hello,

I'm on go 1.27.1 using v3.0.0-beta.25.

I'm running: EXTRA_TAGS=private_mac_apis wails3 dev

The View->Open Developer Tools doesn't work.

I've tried to reproduce something similar to what @mhufsky described in his post:
```
	app.Menu.New().
		Add("Open DevTools").
		OnClick(func(ctx *application.Context) {
			window := app.Window.Current()

			if window != nil {
				window.OpenDevTools()
			}
		})
```

Doesn't work.

```
	window := app.Window.New()

	menu := app.NewMenu()
	devMenu := menu.AddSubmenu("Develop")
	devMenu.Add("Open DevTools").OnClick(func(ctx *application.Context) {
		window.OpenDevTools()
		window.Show()
	})
	app.Menu.Set(menu)
```

Doesn't work.

I've tried cmd+option+F12, cmd+shift+F12, cmd+option+i...

I'm just starting in Wails, so I don't discard the possibility I'm doing something wrong.

Is this still broken in beta.25 or I'm trying the wrong code?

same on v3.0.0-beta.26

In the meantime, I found a workaround using Safari's remote inspector:

1. In Safari -> Settings -> Advanced, enable "Show features for web developers"
2. Run the app with `wails3 dev`
3. Safari -> Develop -> your Mac -> your app

Not ideal but this opens up the inspector for me until we find out what broke; hopefully it's a simple fix 🤞.
